title: Professional PDC Darts Equipment & Setup Specifications Directory
source: Equipment Manufacturers (Target, Winmau, Red Dragon, Unicorn, Shot, Dynasty, One80) & Official Player Disclosures
equipment_overview: Professional darts players utilize bespoke tungsten dart barrels engineered to exacting tolerances of ±0.05 grams. Match weights range from Stephen Bunting's 18g (famously 12g historically) to Nathan Aspinall's heavy 26g and Ryan Searle's circuit-topping 32g, with 21g–24g serving as the general competitive standard on the PDC circuit.

lightest_profile.notes: Threw ultra-light 12g darts for years before moving to 18g Gen 5 in 2023.

heaviest_circuit_dart.notes: Throws the heaviest match barrels on the professional PDC circuit.

heavy_top_seed.notes: One of the heaviest match setups among top-16 competitors.

player_setups.name: Luke Littler
player_setups.grip_style: Dual Pixel and Radial Groove Cut
player_setups.shaft: Target Pro Grip Short (or Target K-Flex)
player_setups.flights: Target K-Flex No.2 Integrated Flight & Shaft System
player_setups.notes: Littler uses Target's patented Swiss Point technology allowing point replacement in seconds using an SP tool.

player_setups.name: Luke Humphries
player_setups.model: Red Dragon Luke Humphries TX1 Original
player_setups.notes: Features a front-loaded taper specifically weighted for flat, consistent trajectory through the air.

player_setups.name: Michael van Gerwen
player_setups.model: Winmau MvG Exact Original Match Barrels
player_setups.grip_style: Full Length Ring Grip with Natural Wear
player_setups.notes: Van Gerwen famously used the exact same worn set of barrels for over a decade before Winmau replicated the exact weathered contours.

player_setups.name: Gerwyn Price
player_setups.model: Red Dragon Gerwyn Price Iceman Original / Avalanche
player_setups.grip_style: Modified Buttress Grooves with Blue PVD Finish
player_setups.flights: Hardcore Extra Thick Standard Iceman Signature
player_setups.notes: Aggressive razor grip designed for maximum finger traction through high-torque delivery.

player_setups.name: Michael Smith
player_setups.grip_style: Square CNC Ring Cuts with Red Inlays
player_setups.flights: Shot Michael Smith Signature Standard No.2
player_setups.notes: Smith partnered with New Zealand manufacturer Shot Darts in 2023 following his World Championship victory.

player_setups.name: Peter Wright
player_setups.model: Red Dragon Euro 11 / Supa-Venom / World Champion SE
player_setups.notes: Wright is the most prolific equipment tinkerer in darts history, regularly changing barrel profiles and flight setups mid-tournament.

player_setups.name: Gary Anderson
player_setups.model: Unicorn Gary Anderson Phase 3 / Phase 5 World Champion
player_setups.grip_style: Dual Blue Ring Recesses with Clean Radial Grooves
player_setups.flights: Unicorn Gary Anderson Signature Ultrafly Standard
player_setups.notes: One of the most popular and commercially successful player dart designs in world history.

player_setups.name: Stephen Bunting
player_setups.model: Target Stephen Bunting Gen 5 (18g Match Weight)
player_setups.grip_style: Precision Radial Grooves with Natural Tungsten Finish
player_setups.shaft: Target Pro Grip Short / Target K-Flex
player_setups.flights: Target K-Flex No.6 / Pro Grip flights
player_setups.notes: Bunting famously threw ultra-light 12g darts for the majority of his career before switching to 18g Target Gen 5 barrels in 2023, which propelled him to his 2024 Masters title. At 18g, his darts remain among the lightest thrown by an elite professional on tour.

player_setups.name: Nathan Aspinall
player_setups.grip_style: CNC Milled Rings with Black and Red PVD
player_setups.notes: Aspinall favors a heavy 26g barrel for stability through the air and authoritative board entry, placing him among the heavier throwers in the PDC top 16 (though tour-wide, Ryan Searle holds the heaviest mark at 32g).

player_setups.name: Rob Cross
player_setups.flights: Target Rob Cross Signature Standard No.6
player_setups.notes: Simple, uncluttered barrel design that delivered Cross the 2018 World Championship in his rookie year.

player_setups.name: Raymond van Barneveld
player_setups.grip_style: Milled Trapezoidal Grip with Titanium Carbon Coating
player_setups.shaft: Target Heli Ti Shafts / Pro Grip
player_setups.notes: A heavyweight 25g front-loaded dart engineered to suit Barney's smooth, deliberate arm extension.

player_setups.name: Fallon Sherrock
player_setups.model: Dynasty A-FLOW Black Line Fallon Sherrock Signature
player_setups.grip_style: Shark Fin and Ring Grip Hybrid
player_setups.points: Hard Lip Point / Steel Tip Points
player_setups.notes: Engineered with Japanese precision manufacturer Dynasty, paired with high-rigidity L-Style molded flights.

player_setups.name: Beau Greaves
player_setups.model: One80 Beau Greaves Signature Match Barrels
player_setups.grip_style: Fine Micro-Ring Cuts with Natural Silver Finish
player_setups.notes: Clean, unpretentious 21g barrel that gives Greaves complete fingertip consistency across her high-velocity delivery.
